research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: BetterCloud is researching methods and systems to manage data objects in a cloud computing environment, focusing on managing activity related to cloud-based software services. Their work involves a platform that oversees data objects processed by software services and the entities initiating processing events, utilizing identifiers to track and centralize operations. This research addresses centralized data protection, operational efficiency, and employee experience in SaaS environments.

overview_description.description: BetterCloud is the market leader for SaaS Operations. With SaaS adoption growing 38% YoY, an average IT team is now responsible for managing and securing 110+ SaaS applications. Existing solutions are not designed to handle aggressive SaaS sprawl. By automating critical work like user lifecycle management and data protection, BetterCloud's 1000's of customers enjoy greater employee productivity and more secure IT environments. With unrivaled SaaS expertise and a powerful integration library, BetterCloud’s SaaS Management Platform typically enables true "Zero Touch" SaaS operations in less than 2 months.

about_short_description.short_description: BetterCloud is a SaaS Operations leader: Transform employee experience, centralize data protection, and maximize operational efficiency.

product.name: BetterCloud SaaS Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for discovering, governing, automating, and optimizing an organization’s SaaS applications, users, licenses, data, and AI tools.

product.name: IT Agent
product.description: A natural-language interface for querying SaaS environments and initiating governed IT actions, with approval controls and the ability to reverse completed actions.

product.name: User Automation
product.description: A no-code workflow automation capability for managing employee onboarding, offboarding, access changes, help desk tasks, and other SaaS administration processes.

product.name: Spend Optimization
product.description: A SaaS spend management capability that tracks applications, contracts, licenses, usage, renewals, and departmental costs to reduce waste and improve software investment decisions.

product.name: File Governance
product.description: A SaaS data protection and file governance capability that scans cloud files, identifies sensitive or improperly shared content, and automates permission remediation.

product.name: BetterCloud Professional Services
product.description: Implementation, advisory, integration, and training services that help customers deploy BetterCloud, build workflows, and apply SaaS management best practices.
